description: Probabilistic Severe Wind Impact to Separate Residential Houses Based on BOM TC Statistical Ensemble Forecast is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. Severe wind from tropical cyclones (TCs) can cause significant damage to property and infrastructure, so impact predictions can inform community safety measures. At Geoscience Australia (GA), the Tropical Cyclone Risk Model (TCRM) is an open-source, statistical-parametric tool designed to estimate the severe wind hazards posed by TCs. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data. Its tags are Adverse weather events, Published_External, ensemble, severe wind, tropical cyclone.
